prompt:
Recreate the standalone saved-view breakdown card shown in the primary original Linear screenshot crop. Match its 494:166 aspect ratio (about 2.98:1), rounded outer white panel, thin neutral border, compact tab row and two result rows. The original screenshot controls the geometry, selected state, icon art, colors, counts and owner identity; use the Japanese mock only for translated labels.

At the top, show three evenly spaced rounded tabs: 「担当者」 selected with a very light gray fill, then 「ラベル」 and 「案件」 unselected with subtle outlines. Below, show exactly two compact rows. First row: the original pale-gray unassigned-person icon, label 「担当者なし」 and right-aligned count 「12」. Second row: the original small purple circular avatar with white AM initials, exact source owner email 「alexsmith.mobbin@gmail.com」 and right-aligned count 「2」. Do not replace this account with the mock's placeholder Japanese name or mint avatar.

Keep the source's left insets, baseline alignment, row spacing and far-right count column. Use compact Japanese UI text, restrained gray icons and text, white surface and light border. Do not add titles, extra rows, extra counts, page context, or unrelated controls.
reviewNotes: Candidate v001 visually preserves the selected assignee tab, the Japanese labels, the original no-assignee icon, purple AM avatar, exact email, and counts. Dimensions are 2164x727 (2.9766:1) against the 494x166 source crop (2.9759:1); SHA-256 cb2b76b6c1324233c725bcd2e873981ec7d72e7ea74dfa0c4030ba19dd84e980. The rows are vertically compressed relative to the source: the first row aligns, but the second row sits noticeably higher and leaves excess space at the card bottom.
